page_title: BET 1-2 BIL | Betis v Athletic Bilbao 31/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Junior Firpo (Betis) receives a yellow card for chasing the referee and shouting at him.
90+11' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) was probably a bit loose with his words to Isidro Diaz, who decides to show him a yellow.
90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+9' There is a red card in the referee's hand. It points straight to Alex Padilla (Ath Bilbao), who has to leave the pitch immediately.
90+8' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

90+7' 1 - 2 Junior Firpo sends a superb cross into the box. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header inside the right post, leaving Unai Simon beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:2.
90+6' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+6' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
88' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Giovani Lo Celso will be replaced by Chimy Avila (Betis).
88' The substitution is prepared. Hector Bellerin (Betis) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Angel Ortiz.

85' 0 - 2 Robert Navarro showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header inside the right post. It's 0:2.
85' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
85' Nico Williams will be replaced by Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao).
85' Substitution. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) has come on for Oihan Sancet.
84' The ball is cleared after Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
83' A precise low pass is received by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
80' Betis restart play with a quick free kick.
80' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) tackles a bit over-zealously and Isidro Diaz blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Betis.
78' Angel Ortiz (Betis) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
75' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Jesus Areso is replaced by Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao).
75' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a change. Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) replaces Inaki Williams.
73' The game has come to an end for Rodrigo Riquelme. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nelson Deossa (Betis).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Garcia leaves the pitch and Cedric Bakambu (Betis) comes on.
72' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz had an easy-decision to make.

69' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) won himself some space after the corner kick and tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes the save.
69' The referee awards a corner and Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) goes over to take it.
67' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alvaro Valles is well positioned and punches the ball away.
65' That's unlucky! Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
63' Referee Isidro Diaz points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Ath Bilbao players celebrate.
62' That will be all from Benat Prados Diaz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
61' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Ath Bilbao players aren’t happy.
60' 0 - 1 What bad luck! Marc Bartra (Betis) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 0:1.
60' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) works the corner short.

59' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ath Bilbao.
57' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires from the edge of the box to the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon is equal to it.
56' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
56' Dangerous play by Angel Ortiz (Betis). Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
52' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
52' Pablo Garcia (Betis) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
50' A clever short pass gives Cucho Hernandez (Betis) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post.
48' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sprays a pass out to Alex Berenguer, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
46' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
46' Referee Isidro Diaz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+1' Sergi Altimira (Betis) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
45+1' Isidro Diaz shows a yellow card to Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) for his blatant foul.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
43' Isidro Diaz blows for a foul after Cucho Hernandez (Betis) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Ath Bilbao are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
41' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings it in and Inaki Williams gets on the end of it, but Alvaro Valles shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
36' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
33' A cross from a corner kick by Betis is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.

32' Pablo Garcia (Betis) gets into a promising shooting position on the edge of the box after a nice pass, but his effort is deflected onto the post by one of the defenders. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
31' Poor challenge! Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for tripping and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle.
28' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
27' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar.
25' Pablo Garcia (Betis) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

24' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar.
24' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) steps up to send the ball in.
24' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Ath Bilbao force their opponents to concede a corner.
22' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Pablo Garcia (Betis), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
21' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) latched on to a fine crossfield pass on the edge of the box and lashed a shot straight at the goalkeeper, who made an easy save.
17' The ball is crossed into the box and Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Alvaro Valles gets a glove on it to thwart him.

15' Ambitious effort from Giovani Lo Celso (Betis). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.

12' What an opportunity! Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
11' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
9' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
7' Betis are ruled offside.
6' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
1' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Betis will take the kick-off.
Isidro Diaz was nominated as the referee for this game.
